svg.title: The language tree and the script tree, facing
svg.desc: 4597 languages with a script on record. Left, Glottolog's classification cut to 165 leaves; right, the descent tree of the 115 scripts they are mainly written in, with their ancestors. Band thickness is the number of languages.
svg.text: TWO TREES THAT DO NOT LINE UP
Where languages come from, left, and where their scripts come from, right. 4,597 languages with a script on record, each once, under its main script.

g.text: Olck Ol Chiki (Ol Cemet’, Ol, Santa 1

svg.text: Left: a clade is opened while it holds 40 or more written languages and lies within 4 levels of its family; its subclades of fewer than 10, and languages directly under it, are pooled as 'other' (dashed). Families with fewer than 10 written languages are pooled.
Right: every script that is the main script of a language, and its ancestors, in descent order; an ancestor that writes none of these languages is shown by its code only.
Band colour is the script's great lineage (key above). A language with several scripts is counted once, under its main script.
Sources: Glottolog 5 CLDF classification (CC-BY-4.0); Wikidata P282, Unicode CLDR and SIL langtags for scripts. Built by render_trees.py from out/dataset.json.
